# ForgeMoji

> Original Unicode emoji artwork for local bundling, with PNG and SVG assets and JavaScript lookup.

## Documentation

- [Asset integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/forgemoji/blob/main/README.md): Use the manifest and local assets, and check artwork terms.
- [Package exports](https://github.com/forgesworn/forgemoji/blob/main/package.json): JavaScript entry point, manifest and asset paths.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/forgemoji): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
